title: Positive-power transport from one module comparison
statement: Let g:X→Y be a scheme isomorphism, R and S commutative ring sheaves on their small pro-etale sites and c:g⁻¹R≅S. Let F be the identified-coefficient module pullback [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For R-module M and S-module N, fix e:F(M)≅N. Using the nonnegative tensor powers with zeroth power the coefficient unit [def-pur-twist-sheaves, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], there exists P_d:F(M^tensor d)≅N^tensor d. P_0 sends a unit-inserted scalar a to its specified coefficient image, P_1=e, and P_(d+2) sends the unit-inserted pure tensor x tensor y to P_(d+1)(eta x) tensor e(eta y), for every site object, section x of M^tensor(d+1) and section y of M. This statement uses no root sections or local freeness.

proof.text: At zero use the canonical pullback-of-unit isomorphism and its adjunction normalization. At one use e. At each successor compose the binary tensor pullback comparison with the tensor of the preceding isomorphism and e. Nat.rec gives this family, and the two tensor functoriality equations give exactly the asserted pure-section recursion.

mathlib_searches.query: Inverse image along an isomorphism of ringed sites extends the canonical inverse limit of roots of unity to integral and finite coefficient Tate lines
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including Scheme.inv_app and stalk isomorphism lemmas; none states the root-limit coefficient comparison. A second query on maps from sheafified tensor powers returns SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections and sheafification maps, which do not establish generation by these root tensors.

TensorProduct.ext in Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Basic supplies ordinary tensor extensionality. It does not state sheafified root-power generation or normalized inverse-image maps. Earlier SheafOfModules, _ ≅ _ query returned general module isomorphisms only.

msearch Mathlib grep: zero hits. Local library search finds the normalized signed-line API and integral tensor transport, but they require local freeness or invertibility of l; the present original theorem assumes only that g is an isomorphism. The canonical ordinary tensor pullback theorem is already proved and is used for power induction. Blueprint searches for root tensor, generator-normalized, internal Hom comparison and 03EL found no identical node.

lean.statement:
theorem frobeniusPositivePowerTransport
    (M : proEtaleRingModules Y R) (N : proEtaleRingModules X S)
    (e : (proEtaleRingModulePullback g R S c).obj M ≅ N) :
    ∃ P : ∀ d : ℕ, (proEtaleRingModulePullback g R S c).obj
        (coefficientTwistPower Y (R := R) M d) ≅
          coefficientTwistPower X (R := S) N d,
      (∀ (V : Y.ProEt) (a : R.obj.obj (op V)),
        (P 0).hom.val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
          (((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g R S c).unit.app _).val.app (op V) a) =
          (proEtaleRingDirectImageMap g R S c).hom.app (op V) a) ∧
      P 1 = e ∧
      ∀ (d : ℕ) (V : Y.ProEt)
        (x : (coefficientTwistPower Y (R := R) M (d + 1)).val.obj (op V))
        (y : M.val.obj (op V)),
        (P (d + 2)).hom.val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
          (((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g R S c).unit.app _).val.app (op V)
            (SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorTmul.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1} _ _ (op V) x y)) =
        SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorTmul.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1} _ _ (op ((proEtaleBaseChange
          g).obj V))
          ((P (d + 1)).hom.val.app _
            (((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g R S c).unit.app _).val.app (op V) x))
          (e.hom.val.app _
            (((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g R S c).unit.app _).val.app (op V) y))
